name: Ethnography
description: Ethnography is both a set of qualitative research methods employed in the humanities and social sciences and a mode of presenting that research—in books and articles, film and video, embodied performance, and digital formats.
notes: Minimum grade C in each course
At least four of six courses must be at the 3000-level or above
At least two courses must include substantial methods training and/or a practical ethnographic component, including at least one at the 3000-level or above
Attend two public talks or events featuring ethnography and submit one-page critical reflections on each
No more than two course credits may overlap with a major, simultaneous degree, or another certificate
No course credit may count toward more than two curricular programs
Approved graduate and professional school courses may count
Other courses may be approved by the certificate director
Declare on Yale Hub by January 15 or September 15 of the final semester

nonCourseRequirements: Attend two public talks or other events that feature ethnography and submit a one-page critical reflection on each to the certificate director
policy.sourceNote: No more than two course credits may overlap in the fulfillment of the requirements of the Ethnography certificate and of a major, a simultaneous degree, or another certificate. The minimum grade for all courses is a C.

requirements.name: Ethnography methods courses
requirements.description: Courses with substantial methods training and/or a practical ethnographic component. Searchable in Yale Course Search with the YC Ethnography Methods attribute. At least one must be at the 3000-level or above.

requirements.name: Ethnography electives
requirements.description: Additional ethnography courses. Searchable in Yale Course Search with the YC Ethnography Elective attribute. At least four of the six total certificate courses must be at the 3000-level or above.
